title: Discourse on Metaphysics
summary: Leibniz's first full statement of his mature metaphysics, drafted in 1686 and sent in summary to Antoine Arnauld — the beginning of the most famous philosophical correspondence of the century. God does everything in the most perfect way; each individual substance expresses the whole universe from its own point of view; our ideas are not blank tablets but inner dispositions; and final and efficient causes are two ways of telling one truth.
